svg.title: Straight reference lines guide the axle installation

g.text: Straight reference lines guide the axle installation
ONE front axle line: left bearing ● ────────────── ● right bearing
ONE rear axle line: left bearing ● ────────────── ● right bearing
Check each line is straight → then check front and rear are parallel
Crooked bearing positions → rubbing / unequal drag → poor straightness
Plan view, not to scale. Use your measured layout lines before fixing bearings.
